regions.name: Kastleton (Laslan)
regions.description: A bustling port city acting as the starting bastion of hope against the dark forces.

regions.name: Stonegard Wastelands
regions.description: A harsh, rocky desert filled with ancient monoliths and dangerous canyon predators.

characters.name: Clay Carter
characters.bio: A legendary swordsman who rallied the broken kingdoms after the fall of the capital.

characters.name: Evelyn Thorne
characters.bio: A mercenary born in the Stonegard Wastelands. She steals imperial secrets and sells them to the highest bidder.

characters.name: Kazar the Cruel
characters.bio: The ruthless leader of the legion who uses corrupted mana stones to summon colossal world bosses.

characters.name: Tevent
characters.bio: An ancient monarch resurrected by Kazar's dark magic. He haunts the desert ruins during heavy sandstorms.
